content: As an example, consider the test sentence: “The device will be available on sale on 20th April 2011 on amazon uk Apple's iPad” from Figure FIGREF18 . First, we tag iPad as product using the context encoder described in Section 2.1. We then search Wikidata and return the most common variant for that entity in this case Q2796 (the most referenced variant is the one with the lowest Q-id). We then calculate a cosine similarity of the description, in this case “line of tablet computers”, with the possible subtypes of product. The possible subtypes, in this case, are engine, airplane, car, ship, spacecraft, train, camera, mobile phone, computer, software, game, instrument, ship, weapon. We return the highest result above 0.1, which in this case is computer (0.54).
